about: Clothing variants are kept over save/reload: a cell with variants (test mod harness_outfit), the breast's clothing button clicked once (clothing -> variant 1), save, reload: the cell still shows variant 1. The boot suite runs too: its T21 sprite check once failed every fixed-mode cell with variant lists.

steps.why: a new cell starts at the clothing
breast button: variant 1 (the head goes with it); leg button: no clothing
after reload the cell keeps the choice and still draws variant 1 (it drew the clothing again)
